note: The supported melee strike also strikes twice more at other targets near it (modelled as two repeats at slightly less damage).

def.name: Echoing Blow
def.description: The strike lands twice more on other targets near it.

note: The supported bow or wand attack fires four more projectiles in a tight fan at less damage each.

def.name: Rolling Volleys
def.description: Four more projectiles, each hitting less.

note: Hits can blind enemies (10% chance): a blinded enemy misses half of its attacks. A blind is not a curse.

def.name: Dazzle
def.description: Hits can blind enemies, so that they miss half of their attacks.

note: Enemies block less against the supported skill, and a blocked hit leaves the blocker Overpowered, a further 5% less able to block for four seconds, stacking.

def.name: Guard Breaker
def.description: Enemies block less against your hits, and every block you meet makes the next likelier to fail.

note: Hits can make normal monsters flee (and magic ones half the time); rare monsters do not flee.

def.name: Rout
def.description: Hits can make enemies lose their nerve and run.

note: Hits restore energy shield, and the skill deals more damage while the character is on full energy shield.

def.name: Ward Siphon
def.description: Hits restore energy shield.

note: Raises the quality of the supported gem (modelled as a small increase in damage).

def.name: Refine Gem
def.description: Raises the quality of the supported gem.

note: Lowers the mana cost multiplier of the supported gem group (modelled as a cost multiplier below one).

def.name: Deep Insight
def.description: Makes the supported skill cheaper to cast.

note: The supported attack deals more burning damage and ignites more often, adding fire damage.

def.name: Cindering
def.description: Adds fire damage to the attack and ignites more often.

note: Ignites spread to the enemies nearby when an ignited enemy is killed, and ignite damage rises.

def.name: Wildfire Seed
def.description: Ignites spread from the enemies you kill.

note: The supported skill costs less mana, gains an Insight charge each time it is used, and hits harder in critical strikes and in elemental damage with each charge held (the reference gem's own charge type is Insight here; its reset when much mana has been spent is not modelled).

def.name: Lightheart
def.description: A cheaper skill that earns Insight each time it is used and grows stronger with it.

note: The supported area spell hits harder and wider, the charge-up between uses averaged into a flat bonus.

def.name: Swelling Blast
def.description: Area spells grow in size and strength.

note: More rarity of the items dropped by enemies killed while the supported skill is socketed.

def.name: Scavenger
def.description: Enemies drop rarer items.

note: Shorter zones and ailments for more damage.

def.name: Brief Burst
def.description: The skill's effects end sooner and hit harder.

note: Longer zones and ailments for less damage.

def.name: Lingering Effect
def.description: The skill's effects last longer at less strength.

note: Hits maim (30% chance, four seconds): a maimed enemy moves more slowly and takes more physical damage; the skill deals more physical damage.

def.name: Hamstring
def.description: Hits can maim: a maimed enemy moves slowly and takes more physical damage.

note: A mirage of the archer fires with each attack, a little weaker and slower (modelled as one repeat of the attack).

def.name: Twin Shadow
def.description: A shadow of you fires with every shot.

note: Critical strikes grant Elusive (modelled as a bonus to critical chance and multiplier for the supported skill).

def.name: Veil Cut
def.description: Sharper critical strikes.

note: Melee hits grant Rage, which boosts attacks.

def.name: Fury Well
def.description: Melee hits build Rage.

note: Blunt hits send a shockwave that hits the area (modelled as more melee damage in an area and a wider reach).

def.name: Shattering Blows
def.description: Blunt hits send a shockwave through the enemies around.

note: The supported area spell is cast again on both sides of the target (modelled as two repeats at less damage).

def.name: Flanking Cast
def.description: The spell lands again on either side.

note: The supported spell is cast again, at less damage per cast (the stored seals are averaged).

def.name: Double Release
def.description: The spell is released again at once.

note: A curse under this support is no longer cast: it stands on every enemy the character hits, and reserves mana.

def.name: Standing Curse
def.description: The supported curse stays on every enemy you hit, at the cost of reserved mana.

note: Spells linked to the supported melee skill are cast when it kills.

def.name: Slayer's Echo
def.description: Linked spells are cast when your melee blows kill.

note: Spells linked to the supported spell are cast when the character has taken a heavy blow (a stun is approximated by a large hit).

def.name: Reeling Cast
def.description: Linked spells are cast when a heavy blow lands on you.
